items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Ray Perry, yes, I've played with Ray.

ctx.x: Ray Perry, yes, I've played with Ray. And there was a violinist in Philadelphia by the name of [Wesley] Robinson before I even heard of the rest of these fiddles. But I was a symphony violinist, and I never could play that on the violin, and I guess maybe that influenced my playing the bass. You know, I -- wouldn't have gone anywhere as a symphony violinist.
Yeah, but do you think you would have played jazz on the violin?
